text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I overheard you talking, but... don't get
the wrong idea. This isn't my
"moment."

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! Just say the word, and I
shall use the power of the
golden ring!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm being serious here... Even if I wanted to
help, I'm not registered as
part of your
team.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but you are. I took the liberty of
registering you as a backup
member.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You what?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You even have an outfit. I asked the
director myself!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-wait, you did this when, exactly?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! I had a hunch we might
want someone waiting in the
wings to
swoop in and save the day! Call it
clairvoyance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And when it came to picking our final
member, it could only have
been you! For
you and I clash, lift each other up, and at
times join
hands—we are rivals!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Plus, you too found yourself drawn in by
Doto's wish to bring
happiness to all, did
you not? Your very being here is proof
enough!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-umm, Ayabe? Are you sure you're okay
with this? It's not too much?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Why would you think that?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You said you wanted to focus on racing,
didn't you? Isn't this just
wasting your time
then?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's fine. I'm choosing to help.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I know how hard you guys worked for this,
so... I mean, what choice
do I really have?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Doto.

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
We're just about ready for the final round
of the National
Umamusume Karuta
Championship. Both teams look tense as
their
memorization time concludes.

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Tracen's team had a member swap.
They've changed positions
too. Guess one
of their members really did get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind helping, but on one
condition... Doto and Opera, you
two swap
roles.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Running in karuta is different from in a
race. After being taker this
whole time,
you're getting tired, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I can't hide anything from you, can I?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-but if somebody has to swap with
Opera, you'd be better than me...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Someone's got to go for the win... and
bring back happiness for all of
us. That's
you, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Y-yeah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: C'mon, guys... Cough, cough! Please... let's not leave here with any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Reciter Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Umamusume, on the cliffs...

text_block_list.name: Opponent Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Got it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: (They're so fast! Or more like we're slow... W-well, figures, those four never practiced together...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(Ooh... I feel so useless... I hate this! In
their time of need I can't even
muster a
single cheer...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(C'mon, team... Please, please... Just get
one card to start!)

text_block_list.name: Reciter Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The clanging of cleats alone, echoes
swiftly into dawn... As the skies

themselves, light up in sunny splendor, on
this springtime day—
Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Great Fortune in the New Year strikes
back! I believe this is the
first time we've
seen this taker step up.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yippee! Fuku, I did it! "Ever so carefree
they grow: buds upon the
cherry trees"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I told myself, I have to at least get this one!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(Yet again she continues to amaze! Even in
a pinch like this, she's got
her eyes right
on the prize.)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(The simple desire to win is something to
nurture, not shy away
from—that's what
I've learned from her!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
URARA! YOU GUYS! Take it one card at a
time! Bring home the wiiin!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto! Go on the offensive—right,
three-five!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: On it! One card at a time!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Urara, set a screen! Cover for Doto!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: No one's getting in Doto's way!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
That one card really gave them a lot of
momentum, and Team Great
Fortune in
the New Year is not letting up.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto, far back to the left!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You can reach it! Run!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We're not stopping here... We're going to
win, and then...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We're going to spend a happy new
year—together!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Our national karuta champions
this year are the rookies from
Tracen
Academy, Great Fortune in the New Year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, at the shrine...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Okie dokie, are we all ready? It's time to
tell the gods all about the
tournament and
pray for this year's good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So... why am I here praying with you guys?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why wouldn't you be? Imagine the shining
star of the thrilling final
act missing the
curtain call—unthinkable!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah... You also gave me the strength I
needed, and got me all
those books on
karuta...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If it wasn't for you... we never would've
even come close to winning!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, can I ring the bell already?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, Urara, hold on a sec! C'mon, guys,
line up, line up! We all have
to say hello
together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
O goddess above, O great Shiraoki! We
have done your will and
endeavored in
competition with friends!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Getting to work together as a team was a
lot of f-fun. We hope to
keep growing
together, s-so...

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text:
Please bless us with another good year
ahead!
